variants.headline: Looking back: home world punishes the colony
variants.sub: A punishment has been imposed on {colony} by the home world.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had punished the colony.

The gazette records the punishment without assigning a particular form to it. A punitive action should be described with due care, since assumptions about its terms could misstate the colony's position. The public interest is served by keeping the known action separate from an inferred account of its operation.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The position of {target} should be assessed without supplying an unreported offence or penalty. This paper records the punitive action while reserving judgment on particulars not established in the report.
